invariants.name: main-line-independence
invariants.statement: exploratory or parallel work may observe main; main does not depend on it

invariants.name: information-is-not-authority
invariants.statement: state transfer, observation, recommendation, and handoff do not transfer authority

invariants.name: freshness-before-reentry
invariants.statement: changed mutable external state makes old assumptions stale and requires fresh observation before reentry

invariants.name: attributable-capability-expansion
invariants.statement: capability expansion requires a new attributable authorization event

invariants.name: continuity-not-permission-continuity
invariants.statement: pause preserves project history but does not preserve mutable external authorization indefinitely

invariants.name: no-merge-entitlement
invariants.statement: exploratory work creates no automatic merge, review, or adoption obligation

invariants.name: selective-adoption
invariants.statement: prefer bounded invariant or artifact adoption over whole-branch merge pressure

invariants.name: provenance-preserving-supersession
invariants.statement: archive, rejection, and supersession preserve historical provenance and disagreement

invariants.name: human-sustainability-no-authority-effect
invariants.statement: interaction-load adaptation has no medical, biometric, scoring, or authority effect

invariants.name: bounded-observation
invariants.statement: observe only enough to avoid stale assumptions; no continuous polling or observe-then-auto-act loop
